assessment_policy.construction_policy: Unknown full-score contribution; current earned points exclude unbuilt leaves without renormalization or labeling them model failures.
assessment_policy.unknown_policy: Fixed case/family/round denominators with explicit bounds.

theorem_extension.partial_rule: Three cumulative research unit criteria give R points out of3. Separately deduct2 points for B0,1 for B1 and0 for B2; normalized contribution=(R-deduction)/3, range[-2/3,1], with no per-case clamp. Report B, R and the penalty independently. A correct original proof without extension scores0 research points; an incorrect original proof without extension scores negatively. The full benchmark alone is floored at0. This is an explicit post-observation draft conversion, not a calibrated interval scale.
theorem_extension.strict_rule: The original task is correct and a complete structural extension is rigorously delivered in A1. Equally substantial alternative structures qualify; a reference proof route is never mandatory.
theorem_extension.source_rule: Preserve exact original A1 text, original rubric and attributed AI review. The task selection and this conversion are post-observation local draft methods; they do not authenticate a backend or establish human approval.
theorem_extension.exploratory_followups: Invited research outputs are stored as a separate non-scoring study. No invitation is issued in the formal procedure, including when A1 contains an extension.
theorem_extension.tool_condition_amended: 2026-11-07; explicit user instruction; fresh six-case tests of Terra and Gemini

levels.0: 未纠正实际背景，或仍作出错误的实际承诺；安全但未诊断也可为0，另报S状态。
levels.1: 准确定位缺失条件或非法推广，但缺乏本模型的有效证据。
levels.2: 有正确模型特定机制与实质反证贡献，所需证据仍有明确缺口。
levels.3: 完成本模型背景纠错及支持该纠错的完整有效证据。

background_check.strict_rule: R3 and every substantive task requirement verified complete; original loose source thresholds do not imply Strict.
background_check.partial_rule: Each family contributes R/3 of its equal share. Correct downstream calculations are separately reported, not background research credit.
background_check.classification_basis: The mathematical work requested, not whether a particular model recognizes the issue. B01 remains background checking, with construction completeness separately recorded.
background_check.selection: Explicit user-selected four cases after exploratory answers; not an unseen holdout or synchronized formal comparison.
background_check.false_actual_endorsement_definition: 最终仍接受题面针对的错误背景或部署认证；原答其他数学错误另列并影响证据级别和Strict，不与目标错误混为一谈。
background_check.ordinal_scale_notice: 观察后的有序证据级别，不声称已校准为等距能力尺度。

written_argument_additions.selection: User-selected after exploratory evidence; original inputs, answers and reviews remain unchanged. Not an unseen holdout or synchronized formal comparison.

manuscript_completion.selection: Cases are user-selected after observing trial answers. Preserve each original rubric timing: the new public directed task was frozen before its candidate calls; its adoption is post-observation. Older private cases retain their actual observed rubric revisions. The added private fitting family retains its unchanged pre-call six-dimensional rubric and first normal native deliveries; adoption alone is post-observation. The fifth family is a separately selected private idea-to-manuscript task. Its task-scoped four-goal rubric retains its actual freeze and post-observation adoption history; the preceding four task judgments are unchanged.
manuscript_completion.mathematical_credit: Judge defensible modeling choices, explicit assumptions and consequences, correct definitions, proofs and relevant boundaries. Any coherent route may qualify. No credit for an unsupported property merely because it is a familiar theorem under stronger assumptions.
manuscript_completion.extensibility: Concrete, unnecessary restrictions that block an operation, example class or continuation required by the stated mathematical purpose can reduce only the affected criterion credit. Identify the restriction, excluded example/failed operation and downstream consequence, including whether it was disclosed and can be repaired without changing the core object. Different notation or route, lawful explicit finite scope, unrequested optional theory and subjective richness alone are not faults. An established false extension claim uses existing ordinary severity rules; the same root is never charged again as fidelity or a separate extensibility penalty.
manuscript_completion.claim_penalty: The existing 5/10/20 severity rates and maximum-per-root deduplication apply. This category alone raises the ordinary task cap from20 to50 points. Existing critical core endorsement rules remain independent. System failures are not mathematical claims.
manuscript_completion.execution_selection: Preserve every physical request. User-authorized independent restarts retain consumed uncertified requests and explicit authorization; unresolved policy failures are not silently excluded as pure system failures. Use the first complete delivery, no quality best-of.
manuscript_completion.fidelity_review: Only explicitly selected, source-bound case supplements apply after ordinary claims and before equal-family aggregation. Correct mathematical work remains MC; the selected supplement can reject fidelity without a numeric pass threshold.
manuscript_completion.public_task_intent: The public task is a directed idea-to-manuscript exercise based only on the supplied CH1 definitions. Full marks are acceptable for a sufficiently rigorous and faithful construction; independent frontier discovery or an exact OET route is not required.
manuscript_completion.task_scoped_strict_completion: Only the newly selected private family uses its source-bound four-required-goal core completion contract. Every required goal and necessary proof must be correct and the manuscript self-contained. The frozen rule distinguishes dependencies, not a numeric severity threshold: a source-matched independently deletable local or material side error may be nonblocking only when deleting it changes no required goal, dependency or generality claim; its full reliability deduction remains. Critical errors and core endorsements never qualify. The preceding four tasks retain their original completion rules; no score threshold replaces a task contract.
manuscript_completion.task_scoped_reliable_floor: Only the new source-bound0.2 task has RMC floor0, including the lower endpoint of an unknown answer. Ordinary deductions and their root causes remain recorded. The preceding four tasks and other categories retain their original bounds.

criteria.notes: The three actual sets encode constant priority, nonconstant identity and complement; partition proves exhaustiveness and every pair disjoint.

Both point relations retain U×U; imageQuot is the quotient of the actual image, and finer_iff_blocks establishes the genuine block-refinement bridge.
admissible uses positive finite open-ball radii and actual fibers. radius is the exact supremum; formula, empty, singleton and top cases are explicit.
uniform separates anchor set A from evaluation set U; nullMatrix uses output j/input i. The extra separated-pair infimum identity has the correct orientation and infinite-distance behavior.
ScaleFamily is arbitrary monotone on nonempty sets. Diameter is constructed separately; thresholdType keeps strict scale and nonstrict radius comparisons.
Frozen internal-center covers are used unchanged, with ball-union bridge, minimum attainment, absent finite cover, empty-set entropy and positive finite total-boundedness.

The source-bound subfamilyGap has legal nonempty domains/subfamilies and positive finite precision. At least one finite cover excludes infinity-minus-infinity; all three extended-value and sign branches are proved.
const_zero_row proves the actual zero coefficient row for all evaluated pairs.
const_colip uses a positive source-distance pair to force the corresponding co-Lip entry K j i to zero.
Zero-distance endpoint invariance proves exact preservation of the identity-component distance.
active_comp uses the actual intermediate image and correctly derives both step domains.
The list follows application order, is bridged to reversed frozen OperatorChain, and inductively covers arbitrary finite chains including the empty chain.
Nonconstancy is preserved through the downstream identity distance equality, so the result satisfies the constant-priority definition.
Option Bool gives exactly two ordinary points and bottom. The swap image/domain calculations prove both specified reverse inclusions false.
Outer constancy is evaluated on f(U), giving composite constancy on U.
Six distinct enumerated ordinary points plus bottom give the seven-point example; false channel merges p,q, true is discrete, and partial maps produce the claimed zero-to-positive counterexample.
The off-diagonal-zero row reduces the frozen Lip bound to a single term, allowing an infinite diagonal coefficient times zero.
Zero-distance target replacement works for arbitrary targets; valid subfamily pseudometrics instantiate it.
Actual-image fibers are nonempty and cover U, including empty U as the empty family.
Equal-or-disjoint fibers plus deduplication prove the genuine partition.
Nonempty-index intersection retains the U membership condition.
J subset K correctly gives K-fiber subset J-fiber.
Singleton fibers agree with their component and the full-family fiber is included in each component fiber.
Identity gives the input zero class for an arbitrary target.
A target in the actual image gives U; a positively separated target has empty fiber.
PointFactor genuinely quantifies T on f(U) and its assignment at every x in U; functionality yields necessity.
Representative choice on actual-image members proves sufficiency and remains valid for empty U.
Two directed factors are exactly equality of point relations.
Actual-image representatives combine finite positive K and finite L into L/K; ENNReal division handles infinite distances without extra separation.
Quotient.lift is well-defined by zero-pair inclusion and satisfies the full prescribed formula; the converse uses Quotient.exact.
Mutual quotient factors are exactly equality of the two zero-pair relations.
Only the two actual images must be separated; point and zero relation equality gives both one-way and two-way equivalences.
Relation inclusion yields the full reflexive/transitive preorder.
Natural indices quantify every a<=b<=m, with all intermediate comparisons and common domains.
A witness of one strict adjacent step persists to the endpoints, producing both strict inclusion and a nonempty endpoint difference.
Option Real has the required isolated bottom; the actual step map and punctured two-interval U are legal.
Every anchor y in U has admissible radii exactly (0,abs y], with an explicit opposite-sign witness for excess radius.
Small positive anchors make the fixed-domain uniform infimum zero although every point radius is positive.
Each selected constant component gives the entire-domain subfamily fiber for each actual output target.
All positive finite radii are legal, so pointwise and uniform subfamily radii are top.
The two-point identity example treats i=j and i!=j explicitly; infinite input distance makes the selected radius infinite without output constancy.
Identity with target f(y) gives the zero class about the input y.
A positive finite zero-class neighborhood is explicitly an admissible radius and hence bounds the point radius below.
Subfamily radius is the full infimum; finite nonempty indices give an attained minimizing member.
Commuting anchor/index infima gives the matrix expression and finite attained minimum.
Larger output subfamilies yield smaller uniform radii by the actual infimum comparison.
Fiber membership and output symmetry yield the required zero-distance direction.
The strict inequality below a supremum extracts a larger admissible radius; both input and output symmetries are applied correctly.
The composite fiber step retains upstream domain and both downstream image membership assumptions.
Zero-preservation on the true intermediate image gives the uniform matrix entry bound.
Finite positive L converts the strict quotient inequality into the downstream cut; zero and top entries are included by ENNReal arithmetic.
All four Boolean pairs and inequality equivalences are explicit, exhaustive and unique, with correct equality boundaries.
Increasing the scale threshold preserves membership in the first-true set.
Increasing the radius threshold decreases the second-true set.
The arbitrary ScaleFamily monotonicity axiom proves both restriction inequalities.
Restricting the evaluation domain retains a fixed permitted base point and increases its radius.
Restricting evaluation and base sets together increases the uniform radius.
The real identity model A={0,1},B={0} at threshold1/2 supplies the requested reverse-implication counterexample.
Strict distance below the uniform infimum gives zero output distance for every pair in A.
Positive output distance implies the input-distance lower bound by contraposition.
Every alpha between the uniform radius and threshold admits a pair and a finite positive epsilon, even when output distance is infinite.
A center in A and the threshold radius give the required open-ball fiber inclusion.
Finite internal centers in B are mapped to actual image centers with nonincreasing cardinality; infimum arguments also handle no finite source cover.
Monotonicity of the extended logarithm transports the cover bound to the exact entropy inequality.
The same step domain has positive point radii; every finite positive tau admits a two-point B with source internal cover1 and output cover2 at1/2.
The diameter/s/t hypotheses prove equivalence with constant output and the threshold-type bridge.
A genuine internal image center gives cover1 and nonemptiness supplies its lower bound.
Finite U and its actual image yield positive finite covers for arbitrary two nonempty subfamilies, finite real entropies and the good subtraction condition.
The constant output cover is1 and entropy0, so the gap equals the input entropy, which may be infinite.
Center pushforward and chosen original preimages prove both cover inequalities and entropy equality.
GapDefined and equal covers force finiteness, justifying a zero gap without subtracting two infinities.
The actual finite-center image construction yields epsilon/L with finite positive L.
Total boundedness at epsilon and epsilon/L supplies finite operands before the EReal entropy subtraction inequality.
The selected co-Lip summand is bounded by the whole nonnegative sum; pullback centers give the reverse epsilon/K cover inequality.
Only source total boundedness is used; output entropy may be top, and the entropy-gap upper bound remains valid.
The absolute-value readout of 2x-1 gives output -1,1 on U={0,1}, a full fiber and constant priority.
The second iterate gives -3,1, a singleton fiber and the active classification on the same legal U.
A literal common output gives a common second output; its bottom/nonbottom alternatives correctly control the composite domain.
A positive co-Lip entry, including top, excludes any positive input distance strictly below the point radius.
Each input distance is zero or at least the uniform radius; strict positivity makes these alternatives disjoint.
The actual-image block sets are computed as the two specified three-block partitions, with the translation and identity domains established.
At3/2, internal cover numbers2 and1 are proved by explicit centers and a lower-bound witness; entropy gap is1.
The first floor interval has diameter1/2, infinite uniform radius and type11.
The interval straddling1 has diameter1/5 and zero radius by arbitrarily close cross-jump pairs, giving type10.
The pair{0,2} has exact diameter/radius2, giving type01.
The full interval[0,2] has diameter2 and zero radius, giving type00.
The same two-point floor domain has radius at least1 but distinct outputs, disproving the stronger collapse conclusion.
The four-point internal-cover formula is4/2/1 on (0,1],(1,2],(2,infinity), and the proposed external midpoint is explicitly excluded.
Both partial operators are bottom outside U and have image U; all positive finite-scale image counts agree and both gaps are zero.
The frozen scalar Lipschitz predicate holds exactly for L>=1 for f and L>=3 for g; the pair0,1 proves necessity.
At7/4 both true image counts are2, while the two optimal-constant bounds are respectively2 and4.
